item.title: Local swimmers heat up pool at Scott Elliott Invitational at West Chester University
item.description: WEST CHESTER — It was a celebration of swimming on Saturday at the ninth annual Scott Elliott Invitational held at Graham Natatorium on the campus of West Chester University. The meet, which included all Ches-Mont League teams and Devon Prep, is named after the former WCU assistant coach, who primarily led the breaststroke and individual medley relay groups. item.title: Mason Chamberlain’s pin helps Malvern Prep claim state title
item.description: BRYN ATHYN — It was a bit of déjà vu for Malvern Prep, Saturday, as a familiar name managed a familiar result to help a rare outcome. Like his older brother, Brian, did three years ago, freshman Mason Chamberlain (190 pounds) shook off an early takedown and headlocked his foe for a pin in the Pennsylvania Independent School Wrestling tournament at the Academy of the New Church.
